title: Symmetry of the correlated Gaussian density
statement: Let $0<\rho<1$ and $z_1,z_2\in\mathbb{R}$. The joint density obtained by taking a standard normal first coordinate and, conditional on its value $z_1$, a normal second coordinate with mean $\rho z_1$ and variance $1-\rho^2$ is symmetric in its arguments: its value at $(z_1,z_2)$ equals its value at $(z_2,z_1)$.
